question: In which year did Rangrajan Committee for estimating poverty line submit its report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rangarajan Committee**, appointed by the Government of India, was tasked with estimating the **poverty line** and suggesting a new methodology to measure poverty.
 
• The committee submitted its report in **2014**, but it was formed and worked on its analysis starting in **2010**.
 
• The committee’s approach was a revision to the previous methodology used by the **Tendulkar Committee**.
 
• 
 
The **report aimed at creating a more accurate and updated framework for identifying the poverty line across the country.**
